children.text: te cāpi paurā nṛpater vacas tac
na me paraṃ kiṃcid itas tvayā punaḥ
tathā hy avocas tvam ataḥ priyottaraṃ
varaṃ paraṃ te pradadāmi taṃ vṛṇu
tataḥ sa rājā punar eva mūrchitaḥ
dhruvaṃ hy akāle maraṇaṃ na vidyate
idaṃ tu duḥkhaṃ yad anarthakāni me
vratāni dānāni ca saṃyamāś ca hi
mātā naḥ sā yathā na syāt
nibodha mām eṣa hi saumya satpathaḥ
ye ca śeṣāḥ surās te tvāṃ
na te kṣaudraṃ ca dadhi ca
tathā tvayā kāryam idaṃ vaco mama
na ca sma sītāṃ nṛvaro ninīṣati
vanaṃ tu netuṃ na kṛtā matis tadā
na tasya sītā vacanaṃ cakāra tat
puraṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca mahī ca kevalā
tvayā yad uktaṃ nṛpate yathāstu tat
na me tathā pārthiva dhīyate mano
na sarvakāmān na sukhaṃ na maithilīm
vṛṇīya satyaṃ vratam astu te tathā
girīṃś ca paśyan saritaḥ sarāṃsi ca
sutair hi tāsām adhiko hi so 'bhavat
mṛgaiś ca mattair bahubhiś ca kuñjaraiḥ
na śocyās te na cātmā te
sutaś ca bhāryā ca tava prahṛṣṭau
api hy adya kulaṃ na syād
na nv ahaṃ te priyaḥ putra
na hi tv asmin kule jāto
narāś ca nāryaś ca sametya saṃghaśo
babhūvur ārtā na ca śarma lebhire
rātryāṃ tu te tat puram eva yātāḥ
bhayaṃ mahat taddhṛdayān na yāti me
yan me dhanaṃ ca ratnaṃ ca
ūcus te vacanam idaṃ niśamya hṛṣṭāḥ
mā bhūt sa kālo yat kaṣṭaṃ
sa śabdo dyāṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca
tvayā ca sīte saha lakṣmaṇena ca
satāṃ pathi svair niyamaiḥ paraiḥ sthitaḥ
na so 'sti yaḥ syān na gatakramaḥ sukhī
narāś ca kecit tu tam abhyavādayan
guhā girīṇāṃ ca diśaś ca saṃtataṃ
sa vai bandhuḥ sa naḥ pitā
tvaṃ rājā bhava bharata svayaṃ narāṇāṃ
saṃhṛṣṭas tv aham api daṇḍakān pravekṣye
satyaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca parākramaṃ ca
sa tv eva mātṝn abhivādya sarvā
kṣaṇam api na jahau sa rāghavaḥ
kva ca śastraṃ kva ca vanaṃ
kva ca kṣātraṃ tapaḥ kva ca
dharmaṃ ca vaktuṃ tava kaḥ samarthaḥ
kharaṃ ca buddhvā nihataṃ ca dūṣaṇaṃ
hitaṃ ca tasmai hitam ātmanaś ca
ahaṃ tu manye tava na kṣamaṃ raṇe
idaṃ hi bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vākyam uttamaṃ
mṛtyur dhruvo hy adya mayā virudhya
yad atra pathyaṃ kuru tat tathā tvam
sa tvaṃ nāma ca gotraṃ ca
kulaṃ balaṃ nāma ca karma cātmanaḥ
dhik te śauryaṃ ca sattvaṃ ca
na vindate tatra tu śarma maithilī
hṛtā mṛtā vā pathi vartate vā
tathā sa gatvā vipulaṃ mahad vanaṃ
parītya sarvaṃ tv atha maithilīṃ prati
na hi taṃ vedmi vai rāma
tvāṃ ca māṃ ca purā tūrṇam
khaṃ ca gāṃ ca diśaś caiva
tvaṃ tu ko vā kimarthaṃ vā
kiṃ tu yāvan na yāty astaṃ
